messages.subject: Project Tempest - draft Standstill Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Good to speak. Please find our first draft of the Standstill Agreement. It runs to the period to 16 January 2026, suspends Facility B, preserves all of Sterling's rights, and contains the usual information undertakings and milestones (term sheet by 5 December). Standstill fee is left at £75,000 and we have default interest tracking at 1.50%.

Grateful for your client's comments. We're keen to sign this week so the enforcement risk is parked.

James

James Osei | Senior Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Tempest - draft Standstill Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you. Our mark-up is attached. The main points from Sterling: the standstill period needs to run to 27 February 2026 to match a realistic completion date; the fee moves to £100,000; default interest at 2.00%; weekly (not fortnightly) cashflows; and the term sheet milestone to 19 December. We've also added a clause recording the Parent's intention to provide the £4m shareholder contribution.

Subject to those, Gavin is content to sign by end of week.

Nadia

Nadia Iqbal | Pemberton Rowe LLP
